data.body: Phase 4 decision — RP07 (`S04`): REFINED / APPROVED on 2026-08-30. Maintainer direction verbatim: **“Extract handshake only.”** The approved work extracts the cohesive startup-handshake call-graph unit into a focused module, keeps `_mcp_health` as the compatibility/orchestration facade, and re-exports existing handshake symbols. `wire_health` ordering, health-route behavior, instrumentation/offload, SIGTERM/transport handling, signer binding, public imports, and dynamic monkeypatch seams remain unchanged. Reassess remaining pressure after extraction; this item authorizes no broader lifecycle split. Retain cascade/dynamic-reference verification.
